blocks.title: Watch the model think, write and finish — in tok/s
blocks.description: A quiet line under the latest reply shows how fast the model is writing right now, then settles on the turn's real average when it finishes. One click opens the full picture.

showcase.user_prompt: Refactor the payment module and explain what changed.
showcase.assistant_reply:
Done — the retry logic now lives in one place and the three call sites share it.

⏱ 118 tok/s · first token 0.8 s · 1,240 output tokens · 3 model calls

blocks.title: Everything about speed, without leaving the chat

items.title: Live while it writes
items.description: See the speed of the last two seconds and what the model is doing: thinking, writing the reply, writing tool arguments or running tools.

items.title: Settles when it's done
items.description: When the turn ends, the line switches to the turn average with the provider's real token count.

items.title: Details in one click
items.description: A steady side-by-side panel: live trend, first-token latency, call and turn averages, generation time and the token mix of the last call.

items.title: Sees numbers, not words
items.description: Vetta hands the plugin speed and usage figures only. Your messages never reach it.

items.title: Live speed
items.description: Output tokens in the last 2 seconds. Drops toward 0 when the model pauses, so you can tell a stall from a slow model.

items.title: Turn average
items.description: Output tokens ÷ time spent generating. Tool execution and waiting for the first token are not counted.

items.title: First-token latency
items.description: Time from sending the request to the first thinking, text or tool-argument token.

items.title: ≈ estimates
items.description: While streaming, tokens are estimated from received text; real counts replace them when each call ends.

items.title: Install Generation Speed
items.description: Requires Vetta 0.6.32 or newer. Nothing to configure.

items.title: Chat as usual
items.description: In regular and project conversations, the speed line appears under the latest reply.

items.title: Click the line
items.description: Open the details to compare latency, averages and token usage.

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.content: Team conversations do not report speed yet, so the line stays hidden there. The trend chart covers the current turn while the conversation is open.
